# Repository instructions

Read root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first.

`AGENTS.md` is deliberately a **task router**: do not preload the whole documentation set. Read the active GitHub issue, inspect the affected code, then open only the subsystem authorities that `AGENTS.md` says are relevant.

Do not duplicate architecture here. Implementation starts from current `main`, uses a dedicated branch + Draft PR, records exact qualification evidence, keeps GitHub/public outputs secretless and never merges without explicit operator authorization.
